messages:
olivia: kicked off bring-up for mosaic-7b v1.0 (fp16/int8/fp8) across eu-west1/us-east1. running baseline and qprofile sweep.
raj: nice, did you pin kernels? or letting runtime pick?
olivia: letting runtime auto-select but forced int8 kernels on H100 for the initial runs.
mia: quick numbers from eu-west1 H100:

```
fp16 p50 72ms p95 140ms
int8 p50 38ms p95 88ms
fp8  p50 42ms p95 96ms
```

mia: quality delta vs fp16 (eval perplexity): int8 +0.9%, fp8 +0.4% (small prompt set, needs bigger eval)
noah: US-east1 A100 (same batch size) looks worse for int8: speedup ~1.2x vs fp16, p95 ~150ms.
raj: kernel choice explains it — H100 used fused-attn-v2 int8 kernel, A100 fell back to generic int8 path. also different PCIe topology in cloud zone.
olivia: that's the main observation: routing + kernel availability > raw GPU spec in these runs. saw KV cache warmup variance across regions too.
infra-bot: deploy: job 82734 completed (eu-west1 h100) :white_check_mark:
mia: rough capacity estimate: for steady 50 req/s, eu-west1 H100 pool needs ~6 GPUs with int8 qprofile to keep p95 <200ms (assumes autoscaler headroom + 10% traffic spike).
tess: can we run a structured-output/regression canary after quant to catch subtle quality regressions? specifically function-calling fields.
olivia: agreed, I'll create a canary job with the eval prompt set and enable tracing. will also force kernel variant to reproduce.
raj: added a note to the qprofile doc about region-tagged kernel fallbacks and a workaround to bias routing to H100 when int8 is required :thumbsup:
noah: next steps: run larger eval (10k prompts) in both regions, collect token-level diffs and latency histograms, then pick default qprofile.
olivia: sounds good — posting raw logs + flamegraphs after the 10k run.
